# Agent-Team for GitHub Copilot

Follow the provider-neutral policy in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the workflow documented in [README.md](../README.md). Use the planner, researcher, builder, reviewer, and router responsibilities when useful, but do not assume every Copilot client exposes identical agent, model, MCP, or hook capabilities. Follow current GitHub Copilot documentation for client-specific configuration. Never expose secrets; request approval for external or irreversible actions.
